subject: Control runbook & audit windows — roadmap questions for Velox Financial
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@veloxfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Control runbook & audit windows — roadmap questions for Velox Financial

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As Velox considers Redwood for production inference, your security team asked for a compact set of artifacts and a clear runbook we can use during the pre-audit/dry-run phase. I pulled together a short set of questions so we can align on scope and timelines before we hand off to our security operations team.

Quick asks (can you reply inline?):
- Planned audit window(s): do you have target weeks for a dry-run and formal audit between Q1–Q2?
- SIG/CAIQ: do you need a full CAIQ response or only the subset mapped to FedRAMP-like controls?
- ISO 27001: are you planning to assess our ISO scope (services / regions) or just controls that intersect with FedRAMP?
- Evidence packaging: would Velox prefer individual control artifacts (logs, runbooks, config snippets) or consolidated bundles per control family?

I've attached a proposed CAIQ worksheet and an initial draft of a control runbook that maps Redwood artifacts to common SIG controls. Marissa and Grace are looped in to confirm timelines and legal / contract gating items.

If easier, we can schedule a 30-minute intake with your security leads next week — suggest Tue/Wed morning PT.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- velox_caiq_v1.xlsx (CAIQ worksheet stub)
- redwood_control_runbook_draft.pdf (control->artifact mapping)

From: Claire Park <claire.park@veloxfin.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Velox Financial Security Team <security@veloxfin.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Nov 2028 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Control runbook & audit windows — roadmap questions for Velox Financial

Ben —

Thanks — this is helpful. A few notes inline:  

- Planned audit windows: we are aiming for a dry-run the week of 2029-02-05 with a formal audit window tentatively set for 2029-04-08 to 2029-04-19. The dry-run helps our internal auditors validate artifact access and sampling.
- SIG/CAIQ: we need a full CAIQ + SIG mapping for our procurement folder; however our FedRAMP-equivalent assessment will only require the subset that maps to moderate-impact controls.
- ISO 27001: we will validate the ISO scope; at this stage we expect scope to include Redwood-hosted inference in US regions only.
- Evidence packaging: consolidated bundles per control family are preferred for initial review; we’ll request individual artifacts if an auditor needs deeper dive.

Attached a short intake checklist for our team — I can get you the SOC 2 in-scope systems list by EOD Monday.

Can you confirm who will own the artifact handoff on Redwood’s side? Also share any NDA/PSA or packaging constraints we should be aware of.

Claire Park
Information Security Manager — Velox Financial
claire.park@veloxfin.com

Attachment referenced: velox_intake_checklist.pdf (see note: sample checklist only)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@veloxfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 08:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Control runbook & audit windows — roadmap questions for Velox Financial

Claire — appreciate the clarity and the intake checklist.

Ownership: Grace will be primary for evidence packaging and runbook delivery. She'll coordinate the artifacts and staging access. Marissa will lead contract gating (NDA/PSA) and pricing for a dedicated evidence concierge for your audit week.

Action items we will take immediately:
- Grace to confirm artifact owners and a preliminary bundle list by 2028-12-06.
- Ben to provide a CAIQ + SIG mapping CSV (v0.3) and an index of control-runbook PDFs.
- Redwood legal to prepare a short SFTP access addendum and a non-prod artifact access agreement (we'll share drafts for your security review).

Propose a 30-minute kickoff with your security operations on Tue 2028-12-05 at 09:00 PT — does that work for your team?

Best,
Ben

Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Control runbook & audit windows — roadmap questions for Velox Financial

Looping legal and security ops (Grace will take lead):

- Marissa: I'll start the procurement gating checklist and confirm whether Velox needs a PSA amendment for artifact access. Expect an initial draft by EOD 2028-12-07.
- Grace: please confirm the artifact staging approach (SFTP vs temporary GCS bucket) and whether we need per-artifact redaction scripts for any PII-sensitive entries.

Claire — thanks for the timeline. If the dry-run is Feb 5 we should plan a staging window during the week prior (late Jan) to validate access and sampling. Also recommend a short pre-dry-run runbook walkthrough with your auditors so they understand our control evidence layout.

Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
